title: Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act

claims.claim: Agencies must deny applications from small businesses with a security risk connecting them to entities or individuals on any of eight federal watchlists.
claims.sourceSpan: ``(17) provide for-- ``(A) a process under which, upon making an award decision to deny an application on the basis of a determination under paragraph (16) ...''; and ``(F) has a security risk that the Federal agency determines warrants a denial;''
claims.note: Overstates modality as an automatic 'must deny.' The fetched bill text frames denial as a determination-based decision, not an automatic bar; the chapeau of paragraph (16)/(20) that would establish mandatoriness is in the unfetched base statute (15 U.S.C. 638(g)/(o)). Fetched text supports 'may deny on the basis of a determination,' not 'must deny.'
